replication.target_description: Candidate source: A=Kristofferson, McFerran, Morales, & Dahl, (2017), Study 5; B=Promotional ad: scarcity or control ; Perceived competition threat: low or high; C=Selection of a violent video in each of 7 pairs of SNES video games that a participant could play. Requested target: Preference for violent experiences following limited-quantity scarcity promotion versus control, comparing affiliation-task conditions intended to reduce competitive threat versus conditions without that reduction (low versus high perceived competitive threat).
